patch_description: I kept the fixed training pipeline unchanged and redesigned only the ansatz block into a two-stage symmetry-preserving circuit: a mirrored data-lift layer, a compact long-range entangling core, a local CZ scaffold, a mirrored phase-calibration layer, and then a new mixed-axis post-readout entangling tail on mirror pairs. The added tail increases expressivity near the measurement head, while the mirrored parameter sharing keeps the block compact and helps control overfitting and optimization noise.
